notes.title: spellloom - 0.6.5-demo
notes.content:
Greetings, Spellweavers,


Version 0.6.5-demo is now live! This update introduces a major new gameplay system, a formidable new boss, a dazzling array of laser-based spells, and several quality-of-life improvements based on your feedback.

New Content & Features
New Perk System - Spices:

A new mysterious protagonist has been added to the dungeons!

Find him to acquire "Spices," which are powerful perks that can provide anything from minor bonuses to game-altering effects. 

There are currently 20 unique Spices to discover, with more planned for future updates.


New interactable objects have been added to support the perk system:

Reroll Shrine: Don't like the perks you're offered? Use this to get a new selection.
Component Combiner: Mix spell components to generate a perk.
Nullifier: Remove a perk that no longer fits your build.
New Miniboss Encounters: Rooms now have a chance to contain a challenging miniboss. These are empowered versions of standard enemies, enhanced with a random spell Aspect for an unpredictable fight. 



New Spells - The Laser Update:

Over 10 new laser-focused spells have been added!
Discover new "Thread" Aspects to create devastating combinations, including:

Elemental laser beams (Fire, Acid, and Lightning).
Spells that connect your projectiles with a laser beam.
The powerful Laser Anchor ability.
A new rare "Prismatic Barrage" Aspect has been added, allowing you to fire four lasers simultaneously.


New Boss - The Lightharvest:

A new major boss has been added. Prepare to face The Lightharvest and its intense laser-based attacks.
New Enemies:

New enemy variants that wield laser attacks have been introduced to the dungeons.

Visual & Quality of Life Updates

Improved Visual Clarity: All standard enemy projectiles and effects are now colored red to be more easily distinguished from your own spells. Boss and miniboss attacks will have unique colors.


New Visual Effects: Explosions and particle effects have been updated for a more impactful feel.


Component Recycler: A recycler has been added to the start of each level. You can now sell unneeded spell components for a small amount of gold.


Gatemorph Relocated: As requested by the community, the Gatemorph will now appear at the end of the level, after the boss has been defeated.


Let me know what you think, and as always, happy Spellweaving

notes.title: spellloom - v.0.6.0-demo
notes.content:
Greetings, Spellweavers!

Version 0.6.0-demo is now live!
This update brings significant changes to the spell system for deeper, more interesting spell-crafting. You’ll also find new challenges, dungeon-progression tweaks, visibility improvements, and balance adjustments based on your feedback.

Important Note: The number of Aspects available at the start of a new demo run has been increased to 37! The total pool that can be permanently unlocked in this demo is now 58, giving you even more variety as you explore the new systems.

New Content & Features

New Essence

Mine Essence — introduces trap-based playstyles.


New Aspects Added

Ancient Reckoning Aspect
Chain Lightning Aspect
Path Echo Aspect
Path Mark Aspect
Tethered Mine Aspect
Thunderbolt Zap Aspect
Fragmentation Aspect
Singularity Field Aspect
Inferno Burst Aspect
Minelayer Aspect
Crescendo Shot Aspect
Cratering Impact Aspect
Corrosive Cloud Aspect
Siphoning Strike Aspect
Growing Might Aspect
Piercing Aspect
Grievous Wound Aspect
Kinetic Burst Aspect
Oscillating Size Aspect
CryoLock Aspect


New Enemies

Four new enemy types that wield some of the new Aspects, bringing fresh tactics to your dungeon runs.


Systems & Mechanics

Spell System Overhaul — Decoupled Essences & Aspects
Essences now define a spell’s core identity and primary function, while Aspects are distinct, modular modifiers. Mix and match for a vast array of strategic combinations and deeper customization.

Essence & Aspect Synergy System

Certain Essences synergize with specific Aspect Types, boosting the Aspect’s stats and effectiveness.
Essence tooltips list compatible Aspect Types and their bonus multiplier.
Synergizing Aspect tooltips display an “Essence Synergy” breakdown: [code]Base Value + Synergy Bonus = Final Value[/code]


Dynamic Difficulty Scaling
The dungeon’s challenge now ramps up exponentially with each floor, keeping later levels engaging.

Visibility Updates

Character Outlines: Player and enemy sprites now have outlines for better clarity during hectic combat.
Dungeon Clarity: Lighting and contrast tweaks improve overall visibility.


Balance Changes

Special Room Costs Reduced: Resource costs to use special rooms have been lowered to encourage more frequent visits.


Performance & Fixes

Ongoing optimizations for smoother gameplay with many active spell effects.
Several minor bug fixes.


A Massive Thank You!
Many of these changes—especially around spell design and balance—come straight from your testing and feedback. Thank you for helping shape the game!

— Byte Jazz Games

notes.title: spellloom 0.5.0-demo
notes.content:
spellloom v0.5.0-demo Patch Notes - The Guardian, The Weaver, and Unlocks!

Greetings, Spellweavers!

The loom has been working overtime! This update introduces a formidable new challenge, revamps boss rewards, and implements a brand new system for unlocking Essences and Aspects permanently across your runs.

New Content & Features

*   New Boss Encounter: The Spectral Weaver! A new adversary awaits in the dungeon, featuring multiple phases, unique attack patterns, and dynamic movement. Prepare for a true test of skill!
*   Room of The Guardian (Unlock Room): Seek out this new special room, guaranteed on Floor 1 after the spawn room. Spend 'Regalia' currency earned from bosses and minibosses here to permanently unlock new Essences and Aspects, adding them to the item pool for future runs.
*   New Currency: Regalia! Earned by defeating Bosses and the Invocaris room Miniboss. Used exclusively in the Room of The Guardian for permanent unlocks.
*   Reward Pedestals: Bosses and occasionally cleared rooms will now present rewards on interactive Pedestals, offering a choice between several items. Choose wisely!
*   Compendium: Browse all of your unlocked content from the Main Menu's new category 'Compendium'!	

Systems & Mechanics

*   Permanent Unlocks: You now start with a base set of Essences and Aspects. Discover the Room of The Guardian and spend Regalia to permanently add more components to the pool of items you can find in shops, chests, and on pedestals during your runs!
*   Interorb Teleportation System: Navigate floors with speed! Activate Interorbs found throughout the dungeon and instantly teleport between any active Interorb on the current floor by selecting its icon on your minimap.
*   Dynamic Enemy Progression: The dungeon's challenges deepen as you go! New and more formidable enemy types will begin to appear as you conquer floors.
*   Boss Rewards: Defeating a boss now grants Regalia and presents 3 high-quality item choices on pedestals, drawn from components you have unlocked.
*   Room Clear Rewards: Clearing standard rooms now has a chance to spawn Reward Pedestals, typically offering common or rare unlocked components, or useful items like Keys and Health pickups.
*   Miniboss Rewards: The Invocaris room reward now includes a high chance for Regalia and 3 Reward Pedestals with rare item choices.
*   Multi-Invoker Balance ("Invoker Overload"): Using multiple 'Invoker' type Aspects on the same spell now increases its Mana Cost, Cooldown, and Tether Cost, while slightly reducing Base Damage. Check the updated Essence tooltip in for details!
*   New enemies with variants added.
*   More than 10 new Aspects have been added.
*   All of your unlocks will now appear in the new 'Compendium' section in the Main Menu.

Balance Changes

*   Loot tables for Shops, Chests, and the new Reward Pedestals have been adjusted for better progression and rarity distribution, incorporating permanently unlocked items.
*   Shop inventory generation is now based on the new loot tables and only includes items you have permanently unlocked.

Performance & Fixes

*   Optimized performance during intense combat with many projectiles.
*   Improved projectile collision detection for better fairness.
*   Various bug fixes and stability improvements.

Happy spellweaving with the new progression system! Let me know how the unlocks and the new boss feel!

— Byte Jazz Games

notes.title: spellloom v0.4.0‑demo - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, Spellweavers!

I’ve spent the last month weaving code, and this new update is full of new content - new rooms, mechanics, optimizations and quality‑of‑life tweaks.

New Content

Survival Room - Hold out against enemy waves and survive until the time runs out.
Invocaris Miniboss Room - Pray to the Ancients for rewards; certain upgrade rooms are locked behind this encounter.
Augumentis (Aspect Upgrade Room) - Add special modifiers to Aspects.
Modulora (Essence Upgrade Room) - Upgrade your Spell Essences.
Gatemorph (Modifier Reroll Room) - Reroll or lock in the modifiers for the next floor.
New Aspects & Essences - Pulsar, Quasar, and more join the arsenal.


Systems & Mechanics

Only one portal spawns per floor now; the Gatemorph lets you change the modifiers you’ll face.
Some high‑level upgrades require a miniboss victory before they unlock.
Keys are not more important as they have new uses throughout the dungeon.
Loot tables (including the Runchance room) have been reworked.


Balance Changes

Enemy movement and projectile speeds trimmed slightly to give cleaner dodge windows.


Visuals

New room props have been added for a livelier dungeon.


Performance & Fixes

Frame rate optimizations.
Numerous under-the-hood bug fixes.


Happy spellweaving, and as always, let me know what you think!

- Byte Jazz Games
